market_question: Will Solana dip to $20 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Solana has a history of deep drawdowns (e.g., from $260 to below $10 in 2022). Crypto markets cyclical and a bear phase by 2026 could send SOL down 85%+ from current levels. The resolution rule only requires a one-minute candle low ≤$20, capturing flash crashes, making the event more likely than the 9.5% market price implies.
evidence_points: Solana fell from ~$260 to ~$8 during the 2021-2022 bear market, showing it can revisit low levels.
Crypto markets often undergo boom-bust cycles; another winter before Dec 2026 is plausible.
A single 1-minute wick to $20 (not a sustained close) is sufficient for a Yes resolution, increasing probability relative to an average-price condition.
